verses.text: For I know the thoughts that I think towards you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope; and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope. It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees? But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil.
Let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me. Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.

Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you! Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.
I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent amongst you.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God.
The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.
We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.

For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory, while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
Being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.”
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.
For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
All you who fear the Lord, hope for good things, and for eternal gladness and mercy.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.
For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.”
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries towards the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

messages.text: Bw'oba nga tosobola kulaba makubo ga kugenda mu maaso, jjukira nti Katonda ye kkubo.
Essuubi si kye kimanyiddwa ky’olina okukola. Kye kirabo ky’osobola okusaba. Saba Katonda akikuwe kati.
Ekkubo ery'okuziika lyali likakasizza nnyo. Awo ne wajja enkya ya Paasika.
Katonda tannamaliriza ku ggwe. Si leero, era si lubeerera.
Wadde akasiriikiriro k'essuubi katono, kamala Katonda okukolagana nakwo.
Oyinza okuwulira ng'oyagala okulekera awo, naye Katonda tajja kulekera awo kuwe.
Tewali mbeera esukka ku kisa kya Katonda.
Linda olunaku olulala lumu. Oluvannyuma saba Katonda akuwe amaanyi ag'olunaku oluddako.
Mary ayitibwa Maama w'Essuubi. Mubuuze akutwale essuubi lyo bw'oba nga toli na ssuubi.
Ekiseera ekisinga okuba eky'ekizikiza mu kiro kijja nga obudde tebunnakya.
Katonda yaddamu okuzza obulamu mu magumba agakalu. Asobola okuzza obulamu obuggya mu mbeera yo.
Emboozi yo tennaggwa. Omutonzi w'obulamu akyagiwandiika.
Essuubi terigaana bulumi. Likkiriza bukkiriza nti Katonda asinga obukulu ku bulumi.
Tewali kintu kyonna kisobola kulema Katonda. Si kuwona kwo, si biseera byo eby'omu maaso, era si ggwe.
Ssande Monica yasaba okumala emyaka nga talaba ky'addamu. Okusaba kwe kwawulirwa mu kiseera kya Katonda.
Bw'owulira nga tokyalina ssuubi, weegatte ku kukkiriza kw'abalala. Leka ekkanisa yo ekusabire.
Omusaalaba si gwe gwali enkomerero ya Yesu, era okubonaabona kwo si kwe kwali enkomerero yo.
Katonda asiga ensigo mu kiseera ky'obutiti naye ng'omala kuziraba nga zimulisa mu kiseera ky'ekyeya.
Tolina kye wakyuse nnyo. Omusumba omulungi agenda okunoonya oyo eyabula.
Kigambe mpola: Yesu, nkukkiririzaamu. Kikobere nate, ne bwe kiba nga tonakitegeera bulungi.
Essuubi kye kikondo ky'obulamu. Weekwatire ku Kristo, n'olwo omuyaga tegusobola kukutwala wala.
Enkya esobola okuba ey'enjawulo. Katonda afuula ebintu byonna bipya.
Laba emabega ku biseera Katonda by'amaze okukutwala. Takyuse.
Nsaba okutuukirira omuntu leero. Omusumba, mukwano gwo oba omu ku famire asobola okutambula naawe.
Katonda alaba ebiseera byo eby'omu maaso bye tosobola kulaba kati. Weesige amaaso ge ku kutya kwo.
Buli mutukuvu yali musonyiyi eyagaana okulekera awo okusaba ekisa kya Katonda.
Omwoyo omutukuvu asobola okuleeta obulamu mu buli kimu ekirabika nga kifudde.
Ne bw'oba nga tewulira kintu kyonna, Katonda aba akola mu kasirise.
Okusaba okumu, okussa omukka okumu, n'okutambula okumu. Ekyo kimala olwaleero.
Obugagga bwo tebusinziira ku ngeri gy'owuliramu. Oyagalibwa mu ngeri etakoma.
Katonda afuula emiwonko gy'obuzibu okuba enzigi z'essuubi.
Lindirira Mukama. Tatuuka kikeerezi, ne bw'alabika ng'akaluba.
Oli musibe w'essuubi, akwatiddwa Katonda akuuma ebisuubizo Bye.
Kristo azuukidde. Kubanga abeera mulamu, osobola okwolekagana n'ebiro eby'enkya.
Obutaba na ssuubi bulimba. Tekiraga nti tewali kintu kijja kukyuka. Katonda agamba, Laba, nziza ebintu byonna bibe bipya.
Saba omutukuvu Jude, omulabirizi w'embeera enzibu ennyo, akusabire leero.
Omuti ogusaliddwa gusobola okuddamu okukula. Naawe osobola okukikola.
Leka Eukarisitiya ekuliisenga nga tokyalina maanyi. Yesu ye Mugaati gw'Obulamu.
Katonda takulese. Akukutte n'okutuusa kati.
Essuubi litandikira ku kuba nti oyagala Katonda. Mwanjule eri Ye leero.
Tolina kukola ku buli kimu. Leka Katonda atwale ebyo by'otayinza.
Wakyaliyo essanyu eddungi gy'oli mu bulamu buno, n'essanyu ery'emirembe mu liddako.
Buli kimu bwe kiba nga kigenda kuggwaawo, Katonda ye lwazi olutakankana.
Koleeza akataala kamu era osabe. Ekizikiza tekisobola kuwangula n'omuliro omuto ogumu.
Obulamu bwo bukulu nnyo. Bw'oba oli mu kabi, tukusaba okukuba essimu ku 999 oba 112, oba ogambe omuntu amangu ddala.
Santu Pawulo yamenyeka eryato, yakubibwa era n'asibibwa mu kkomera, kyokka era yawandiika ku ssuubi.
Katonda akuŋŋaanya obutundutundu obumenyese n'abukolamu ekintu ekirungi.
Leero, salawo okukkiriza nti Katonda mulungi, ne bwe kiba nga tewali kyakyuse.
Okukkiriza, essuubi n'okwagala bisigala. Binyweza okusinga ekintu kyonna ky'oyitaamu.
Wummula ekiro kino mu kisuubizo kino: enteekateeka za Katonda gy'oli ziri za kukuyamba so si kukukola bubi.
